Hotels.Name: Iberostar Selection Sabila
Hotels.Description:
Named after the ‘sábila’ or aloe vera plant – well known for its healing and health benefits – this luxury adults-only hotel is geared towards relaxation and rejuvenation. With its array of swimming pools surrounded by Bali beds and its position overlooking a curved, sandy cove in the heart of the Costa Adeje, it’s both an indulgent retreat and a great base from which to explore and have fun.

For starters, there’s an enormous spa inspired by the natural benefits of aloe vera to get you in the mood for some serious luxuriating. Then there’s a food court where you can try lots of different cuisines, plus a shopping area, beauty salon, games room and art gallery. The concierge can also help arrange local water sports activities, trips to play golf nearby, and other adventures. And if you just want to stay close to the shopping, bars, clubs and beaches of the Costa Adeje, it’s all only minutes away.

Rooms are finished in clean white décor with splashes of colour, and all come with balconies commanding sea or mountain views. Of course, if you want a different angle on island life, you’re not far from the extraordinary landscapes of the Teide National Park, which will more than reward a day of exploring.

If you really want to treat yourself, go all out and book a Star Prestige room – these rooms are the best in the house, and come with added extras. Star Prestige guests enjoy access to the sixth-floor Sky Lounge, which comes with panoramic views, a semi-private pool, an open bar, and luxurious loungers and Bali beds. There's also an exclusive lounge and a separate reception area, and late check-out is also part of the package.

A beautiful hotel with a huge range of indulgent facilities, the Iberostar Selection Sábila provides an excellent base for your adults-only Tenerife holiday.
